obligations.requirement: Canvas Interaction Playground 0.1 can run all frozen scenarios and exports exact-identity HUD/trace/evidence.
obligations.acceptance: All frozen scenarios have runnable selectors/adapters on required capability profiles and export result/build/scenario/device identity and the required HUD/trace fields. Unsupported or absent required scenarios return exact blockers; fixture setup must use existing canonical operations.

obligations.requirement: Blocking physical checklist passes on required capability-profiled Windows/Web/Android runs.
obligations.oracle: platform observation records bound to exact build/result
obligations.acceptance: The fixed six-scenario checklist is observed on Windows/Web/Android with exact result revision, build hash, platform/device/capabilities and trace/screenshot refs. Every required case passes; missing hardware, unsupported required capabilities or absent human observations remain blockers.

obligations.requirement: Deterministic downstream workload corpus is frozen with scene/view/overlay/candidate/op/invalidation/frame metrics.
obligations.acceptance: Every frozen workload, including the 100K profiles, has content-addressed fixture/trace inputs and independently rerunnable replay output. Repeated replay preserves semantic/presentation digest and deterministic counters; real timings are reported separately. No synthetic timing, generation or invalidation values may stand in for real observations.

obligations.acceptance: Existing Pen/Laser owners coexist with per-view editing chrome; overlay and Laser remain non-canonical, successful Pen commits follow existing semantics and clear/cancel/handoff leaves no stale presentation. Preserve existing brush/Arc regression behavior.

obligations.requirement: G4/G4.5 and accepted A/B regressions remain green.
obligations.acceptance: Run and retain the applicable G4/G4.5 and accepted A/B suite inventory, execution logs and git diff --check. Required failures/Not Run are blocking; no filtering or new waiver based on physical feel. Preserve unrelated baseline findings with their exact identities and disposition.
